leadText:
Drawing Bridges (Japanese: VS ガマガル VS Palpitoad), titled VS Palpitoad in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 489th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 29th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Palpitoad (Japanese: 跳橋 Drawbridge) in the VIZ Media translation and Drawing Bridges in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
plainText:
Drawing Bridges (Japanese: VS ガマガル VS Palpitoad), titled VS Palpitoad in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 489th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 29th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Palpitoad (Japanese: 跳橋 Drawbridge) in the VIZ Media translation and Drawing Bridges in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
A causes havoc on the Driftveil Drawbridge, making people unable to cross it.
With help from Elesa, gets past the drawbridge.
Black faces the trouble-making Zorua on the drawbridge.
Black defeats the Zorua, causing it to flee.
Black meets Clay, the Gym Leader.
